objective: Close the P3-001 fail-open browser-runtime resolver defect: if the preferred application-data runtime/current bundle exists but fails identity/resource validation, fail closed on that invalid current bundle instead of silently falling back to an executable-root bundle. Preserve executable-root resolution only when the preferred application-data current bundle is absent. Add an adversarial regression with an invalid preferred bundle and a simultaneously valid fallback bundle proving the invalid current bundle cannot be masked or downgraded by fallback.
requiredTests: invalid application-data current bundle plus valid executable-root bundle fails closed
executable-root bundle remains usable only when application-data current is absent
